implementation_reviews.scope: Python bridge, durable journal, isolated runtime, deployment configuration and manifest packaging
Frontend lifecycle, backend retained buffers, credential admission and approval cancellation ownership
findings_closed: Late cancelled preparation cannot erase a newer job.
Polling across expiry transitions to a terminal state.
Expired/cancelled/failed/applied frontend jobs clear provider buffers.
Backend terminal jobs retain only bounded tombstone metadata after expiry/drain.
Credential file reads use protected ancestry, no-follow bounded opening and identity checks.
Approval validation owns the shared active lane through cancellation and cleanup.

limits: Read-only code review and finite tests; not implementation refinement, public promotion, native target acceptance or commercial approval.
